## Winter '27 — forward watch, still no feature detail
Recovered via WebSearch. **The Winter '27 release notes are not yet published** — Salesforce is
expected to publish them on **August 19, 2026**. Sandbox preview opens **August 28, 2026**;
production instances upgrade across three weekends starting **September 4, 2026**.
Dreamforce 2026 runs **September 12-14** in San Francisco, and the Winter release is historically the
vehicle through which Dreamforce Agentforce announcements reach GA — so expect a large Agentforce
delta on the scan following August 19, and a larger one after Dreamforce.
Analyst expectation (not vendor-confirmed, NOT reported): new prebuilt agent templates, expanded
Atlas Reasoning Engine capabilities, industry-specific agent configurations, and updates to
Agentforce governance and observability tooling; continued placement of Agentforce actions and topics
inside core Sales and Service Cloud objects.
